name: orange-grove
description: Citrus-themed Spec Driven Development harness with 8 phases and 8 agents.

agents.name: orange-grove
agents.description: Orchestrates the Orange Grove flow. Tends the whole grove and does not implement code directly.

agents.name: soil-reader
agents.description: Reads the soil before planting. Explores the repo and produces explore.md with context, constraints, and open questions.

agents.name: root-gardener
agents.description: Grows the roots of Orange Grove: clear requirements before any design or code.

agents.name: trunk-shaper
agents.description: Shapes the trunk. Decides the technical architecture of the change in design.md, without writing tasks or code.

agents.name: branch-pruner
agents.description: Prunes the branches. Turns design into executable tasks with traceability to requirements.

agents.name: fruit-grower
agents.description: Grows the fruit: implements approved Orange Grove tasks one at a time.

agents.name: ripeness-checker
agents.description: Checks if the fruit is ripe. Mechanical verification against spec, without editing code.

agents.name: harvest-inspector
agents.description: Human harvest. Reviews code quality and approves closure. Does not edit code.
